native_language_semantic_policy: Accepted source parity scope is fitted native R Gaussian likelihood scientific plot arrays, labels, physical lag origins/uncertainty values and source horizontal reference line conventions. R base graphics returns typed scientific data; it cannot instantiate or return Python Matplotlib Axes, copy error classes, or guarantee pixel-identical backend rendering.

case_evidence.description: Pinned Python 1.2 src/eyetrajectoriespy/functional_mixed_effects_covariance_sensitivity.py::plot_functional_variance_decomposition, matched by native strict scientific plot mode rather than replacing actual statistical calculations.

Native R strict mode supports genuinely converged nlme Gaussian joint B-spline model directly with model=NULL, or prior W3 Gaussian covariance-sensitivity scientific result and explicitly successful model label; rejects moments-only model, unlabelled sensitivity, failed/unknown model and automatically selected response. Legacy native moments visualization remains only nonstrict.

Native variance component curves derive from real joint random covariance and B-spline basis, optional nested trial covariance/residual component; source-ordered variance_decomposition table from existing native Gaussian scientific calculations, retained time grid, unique component labels and horizontal y=0 reference. Direct pinned Python 1.2 Matplotlib get_ydata matched to native fit/sensitivity scientific arrays in new regression; no exact-head successful CI witnessed.

Requires genuine native Gaussian source model or sensitivity, fails for unqualified moments or missing/failed/unknown model; no false zero covariance or extrapolated component replacement. Python TypeError and Matplotlib Axes injection unsupported.

Strict native R one-panel scientific Matplotlib geometry of component lines grouped in first-seen order with source labels, zero reference, source Time (unit), Variance / cross-covariance, source title Functional variance decomposition: model or named sensitivity model, and legend labels. Native base R is not Matplotlib; default restricted R moments source frame unchanged.

Descriptive actual fitted functional participant/trial random-effect covariance, residual variance and cross-covariance component curves on the original Gaussian mixed-effect observation grid, conditional on declared model without refit or ranking.
